verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a required human-approval gate on a 'contract' before an agent can claim/work a task ('Nothing runs until a person approves a contract... an agent is about to change your repository'), plus mobile approval and task/intention workflow that precedes any code changes. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of the approval UI/flow beyond first-party docs, and no detail on reviewing the plan's granularity (e.g., diff-level preview) before approval.
